vt. 使感伤

v. look at with sentimentality or turn into an object of sentiment
v. make (someone or something) sentimental or imbue with sentimental qualities
sentimentalized: v. 伤感( sentimentalize的过去式和过去分词 )
sentimentalizes: v. 伤感( sentimentalize的第三人称单数 )
sentimentalizing: v. 伤感( sentimentalize的现在分词 )
sentiments: n. （基于情感的）观点( sentiment的复数形式 ); （对怜悯、怀旧等的）柔情; （失之过度或不恰当的）伤感; 态度或意见
sentinel:
n. 哨兵, 标记
vt. 警戒, 守卫
[计] 标记
n a person employed to keep watch for some anticipated event
sentinel cells: [医] 近肾小球细胞, 近血管球体
sentinel pile: [医] 前哨痔(肛裂下端的痔)
sentinelled:
n. 看守者；哨兵；步哨
vt. 警卫, 守卫；警戒：；在…放哨；在…设岗哨

n. 看守者；哨兵；步哨
